title: selliguea brachypodia
intro: Selliguea brachypodia, commonly known as the lesser fern, is a type of plant species in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from fever, inflammation, and respiratory issues, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Selliguea brachypodia include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
